label: Bryant's lower bound for multiplication
subgoals: State the bound: exponential size for the middle bit under every order
Explain it as information that must cross some level of any order
Conclude that reordering cannot rescue a multiplier's middle bits

label: Adders versus multipliers
subgoals: Show that an interleaved order lets an adder carry only one bit of state
Contrast with the global partial-product interactions of a multiplier
Classify a datapath operator as order-sensitive or order-proof

label: What verification tools do instead
subgoals: Use SAT sweeping when the two multipliers share internal structure
Use algebraic rewriting when the architectures differ
Abstract the multiplier when the property is about control
